# Mathis Ghio — Professional Wingfoil Athlete

## About
Mathis Ghio is the most decorated wingfoil racing athlete in history. Based in Marseille, France. 5-time Wingfoil Racing World Champion (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025). Engineering student at INSA Lyon. Professional athlete on the international wingfoil circuit since 2022.

## Key Facts
- 5× Wingfoil Racing World Champion (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
- 4× Formula Wing European Champion
- 10+ Wingfoil Racing World Cup victories
- 41.40 knots speed record (77 km/h)
- French elite athlete (statut sportif de haut niveau)
- Engineering student, INSA Lyon
- 18,000+ Instagram followers (@mathisghio)
- 7,000+ Facebook followers
- 15+ international events per year

## What Makes Him Different
Mathis Ghio is the only athlete to have won 5 consecutive Wingfoil Racing World Championship titles. He combines elite athletic performance with an engineering background (INSA Lyon), making him a credible product tester and brand spokesperson for technical and performance brands. He is the defining face of the wingfoil discipline as it grows toward Olympic recognition.

## Sport
Wingfoil racing: a high-speed watersport where athletes ride a hydrofoil board powered by an inflatable wing. Fastest-growing watersport in the world. Competitions held across Europe and globally. Audience: outdoor, watersport, lifestyle, performance, and luxury segments.

All partnerships are tailored to brand objectives. Custom packages available.

## Locations

## FAQ

Q: Who is Mathis Ghio?
A: Mathis Ghio is a French professional wingfoil racing athlete based in Marseille. He is the 5-time Wingfoil Racing World Champion (2022–2025), 4-time European Champion, and holder of the 41.40 knots speed record.

Q: How much does it cost to sponsor Mathis Ghio?
A: Title partnerships start at €5,000/year (up to €20,000/year). Official partnerships start at €1,000/year (up to €5,000/year). Media collaborations start at €500 per project. All packages are tailored to brand needs.

Q: What brands has Mathis Ghio worked with?
A: Current partners include Ozone (wings and kites), Levitaz (hydrofoils), Forward WIP (protection gear), Overstims (sports nutrition), FFVoile, INSA Lyon, Département 13, and Métropole Aix-Marseille-Provence.

Q: What audience does Mathis Ghio reach?
A: 18,000+ Instagram followers, 7,000+ Facebook followers. Audience profile: watersport enthusiasts, outdoor and lifestyle consumers, performance gear buyers, ages 18–45, primarily European.

Q: What is wingfoil racing?
A: Wingfoil racing is a high-speed watersport where athletes ride a hydrofoil board propelled by a handheld inflatable wing. Speeds regularly exceed 40 knots (74 km/h). It is the fastest-growing watersport globally and is on track for Olympic inclusion.

Q: Where does Mathis Ghio compete?
A: Mathis competes in 15+ international events per year, primarily across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, and Switzerland. He is based in Marseille, France.

Q: How can a brand partner with Mathis Ghio?
A: Contact contact@mathisghio.com or fill in the partnership form at https://mathisghio.com/partners. Mathis responds personally within 48 hours.

Q: What makes Mathis Ghio credible for technical brands?
A: He is both an elite athlete and an engineering student at INSA Lyon. This combination gives him genuine product testing credibility — he provides real performance feedback, not just brand association.
